actual: Anonymous request redirected from booking history to sign-in.
Invalid password was refused with the generic sign-in message.
All three demo accounts authenticated and landed on their role-specific pages.
Student was denied the administration page and administrator was denied the booking screen.
Administrator created a facility and updated its capacity from 18 to 22.
The name and type filters returned the matching active facility only.
A missing booking purpose was refused by server validation.
Two separate sessions submitted the same held slot. Exactly one got a booking ID and the other got the conflict message.
The successful request was absent from the other account’s booking history.
An administrator approved the pending request and the owner saw Approved in history.
The facility report showed one request, one approval and one approved hour.
An approved future booking prevented facility deactivation.
The owner cancelled an approved request and the other account reused its released slot.
The rejected request appeared in the owner’s history with Rejected status.
Deactivation hid the room from bookers after its active reservations were resolved.
Logout cleared access and a fresh request for Facilities redirected to sign-in.
The staff facility screen fit a 390-pixel viewport without page-level horizontal scrolling.
